desc: Ideation: identify bipartite components, terminal complete bipartite structure, and candidate parity invariants.
Implement brute-force small-N solver and run public samples.
Implement canonical component-type reduced DP (i,o,e0,e1,p) and fix merge transitions.
Replace predict() with corrected even-N rule (o==0: p+i//2 odd; o<=2: win; o>=3: p != f) and update solve_large.
Validate corrected rule via public samples and reduced-state self-test/analysis; confirm counterexamples losing and no mismatches.
Finalize O(N+M) solver with normal stdin output only Aoki/Takahashi.
